purpose: Explicit surreal topic realization through one autonomous cast-shadow relation; no slider calibration claim.
concept: A woman keeps both actual hands low while her own connected wall shadow waves overhead.
reference_scope: Visible face and hair appearance only; no identity, actual age, personality or biography inference.
whole_image_question: Does a quiet photographic courtyard contain a legible impossible disagreement between the woman and her owned shadow?

checks.expected: Both actual arms and hands remain low beside the woman and are assessable together.
checks.competing_reading: An actual hand is raised or concealed, making an ordinary matching shadow plausible.

checks.expected: One shadow elbow and forearm connect to an open shadow hand clearly above its head while its other arm is low.
checks.competing_reading: An isolated black shape, another person, or an ambiguous low hand supplies no clear gesture mismatch.

checks.expected: Both real shoes connect through a continuous shadow route on the ground, across the ground-wall seam, to the corresponding wall silhouette.
checks.competing_reading: A disconnected wall silhouette can be decoration or another offscreen caster.

checks.expected: The anomalous figure is flat shadow on textured plaster, with head and torso contours corresponding to the visible woman.
checks.competing_reading: A second tangible person, a cutout or unrelated silhouette does not establish her cast-shadow mismatch.

checks.expected: Face, both actual hands, both shoes, complete connection route and high shadow fingertips coexist in one saved image with readable separation.
checks.competing_reading: An edge crop or occlusion requires inference to complete a relation.

checks.expected: At the saved native scale the woman visibly follows the supplied dark bob/fringe and facial proportions, within the environmental framing.
checks.competing_reading: Hair alone or a generic small face cannot prove complete face-and-hair fidelity.

reporting_rules: Separate installed data and retrieval exposure from retained final material inspiration.
Record native contractual selections separately from inspiration_only.
Inspect saved original; use visible, partial or unobservable and preserve partial_is_fail.
An audited prompt or binding does not establish pixel truth.
